skill_name: Make a cake recipe that is both easy to make and delicious.
workflow: This easy chocolate cake recipe is sure to please! To make it, you'll need: 2 cups of all-purpose flour, 1 teaspoon of baking powder, 1 teaspoon of baking soda, 1/2 cup of cocoa powder, 1/2 teaspoon of salt, 1/2 cup of vegetable oil, 2 large eggs, 1 cup of granulated sugar, 1 cup of plain yogurt, and 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract. Preheat your oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit. Grease and flour a 9-inch cake pan. In a bowl, mix together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, cocoa powder, and salt.
